items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Damn it to hell, Hiney's drunk again.

ctx.x: And they got two playing, he used to play banjo, too, those men. Him and Pick. I called Pick, that's what I called him. And that blind horse had come along from the gate wasn't open on Chappatula Street. He fought like that. The old grandma Burnett's car. Damn it to hell, Hiney's drunk again. This is awesome. All the pies sold out in the back of the way. Oh, I don't know exactly.
That's all right. No, that's all right. We have all sorts of things on. That's all right.
